# Authentic UI observation smoke cohort (20 games)

Generated by GitHub Actions run 41560453535 from engine revision
`4971dbaa00532f632f9aef2f3b1bd0d6af347f96`, using the current
30-round bounded modeled-opponent engine and adaptive pilot in safe provisional mode.

This directory is intentionally on an isolated branch, **not** in the
live `web/pages/data/game-outcomes` library. It is development evidence,
not a replacement for the existing published 500-game cohort.

| Scenario | Games | Public UI input | Complete research observations |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| mixed | 10 | `outcomes-mixed.json` | `observations-mixed.jsonl` |
| random | 10 | `outcomes-random.json` | `observations-random.jsonl` |

Each `outcomes-*.json` file uses `commander-modeled-outcomes-v1` and
contains each run's `opponent_roles` by seat, full `life_history`,
ordered `ui_observations` with zone and action records, plus up to two
full example replays.

Each `observations-*.jsonl` has **all** ten games' original
`turn_records`, `state_snapshots`, opening hands, life history, pilot
signals and seat-role mappings. One JSON object per line.

The workflow verified:
* The exporter tests and JavaScript Results UI test suite.
* 10/10 runs per scenario and complete raw observations per run.
* Source-aligned turn and snapshot chronology, including opening hand.
* Exactly three identified opponent seats per game.
* Sorted table composition matching the three per-seat roles.
* The canonical outcome-publisher validation contract.
* Actual browser Results reader accepting 20 games and finding 7 distinct
  three-seat compositions across the sample.

For the separate UI and analytics workstreams:
* Read the two `outcomes-*.json` files as **fixtures**, not as a new
  production release. The UI code's `DeckGameOutcomes.model([...], key, hash)`
  and `matchupRows(groups,"compositions")` already accept these.
* Derive new card metrics only when the raw observation actually recorded
  their actor, source and effect. Otherwise mark the attribution unknown.
* If you add a UI panel requiring fields not present in `ui_observations`,
  either compute it from the full `observations-*.jsonl` sidecar or add
  a deliberately typed, tested projection to the exporter before the next
  large batch.
* The real test data can be copied into your development branch without
  replacing production `manifest.json` or live simulation results.

Full Actions run: https://github.com/bgoodnight/commander-simulator/actions/runs/41560453535
